result: NOT PASS: A14 reproducible no-continuing-growth plateau not established

decision.reason: All declared processes and tracked lifecycle checks pass, but replicate-01 has a 652 KiB Anonymous/Private_Dirty/RSS rise at healthy cycle 48, with only two subsequent cycles. Its final ten-cycle increase is 656 KiB. Small positive late-window growth also occurs elsewhere. No allocation attribution or predeclared nonzero plateau tolerance demonstrates those residual steps are bounded cache.
not_claimed: complete allocator or driver allocation census
decision.next_gate: Attribute residual private-anonymous increments and demonstrate reproducible stable post-warmup/post-fault behavior on the default allocator; do not advance D-1B.
